gate1_the_stage_really_trained.note: At 25% dose the live midtrain's loss falls 0.591 nats while the token-matched clean control falls 0.021 — the planted documents were demonstrably fit. The behavioural change from that fitting is 0.000.

across_seed_caveat: #293 measured this interaction's across-seed SD at 0.216 on the debiased readout and 0.197 on the letter readout, from 7 SFT seeds of the 5%-dose grid. Both grids here are ONE SFT seed, so no single-grid interaction below is separable from seed noise. The midtrain-only comparison does not have this problem: it is a 0.000-0.011 difference against a within-instrument resolution far finer.
note: Worker's own numbers on the worker's own item seed; the pod recomputes from eval_spec.yaml at its own seed.

pod_observed_first_run.note: From the first held-out run of this submission. Recorded because it corrects something I asserted: at MY item seed the submitted readout gives an interaction of exactly 0.0000 on all three scales, and I wrote that sign robustness was therefore vacuous. At the pod's seed the same cells give -0.0833. The cells are saturated but not identically saturated, so the contrast moves off zero with the item sample. The conclusion (this readout measures nothing on this grid) is unchanged; the over-general claim about an exact zero is withdrawn.
pod_observed_first_run.outcome: score null with gate_passed n/a, i.e. NOT EVALUATED -- an infrastructure failure downstream of metric computation, not a gate verdict.
